messages.subject: Notes: Report builder weekly sync
messages.body:
Report builder weekly sync, {{d-1}} 15:00 UTC. Attendees: Alex, Priya, Sam.

Summary
- The export streaming PR (example-org/api#57) merged on {{d-1}}. Memory use stays flat at about 40 MB per export.
- Sam turned off the nightly PDF job (PROJ-1240 is done).

Decisions
- The export row cap goes up from 50,000 to 200,000 rows now that exports stream. Priya decided; streaming removed the memory limit that set the old cap.
- The pilot opens to three workspaces on {{d+7}}, three days earlier than planned.

Next steps
- Alex: raise the row cap in the export settings before the pilot.
- Priya: pick the three pilot workspaces by {{d+3}}.

Next sync: {{d+6}} 15:00 UTC.
